Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: finished transparent boss-introduction nameplate texture for a Japanese bullet-hell game, only typography, no character portrait. Create ONE horizontal three-line nameplate with perfectly legible exact Chinese and Latin text. Vintage Touhou-style boss introduction lettering: small light cyan Mincho/Songti heading at the top, very large elegant pale ivory-white calligraphic Ming/Song Chinese name in the middle with thin near-black outline and restrained moss olive shadow, bright cyan-blue slightly italic hand-lettered Latin reading below. These three rows are tightly grouped and centered, hierarchy roughly 1 : 2.5 : 1, all strokes legible at game HUD size, understated raster-game lettering, not a logo with ornaments. Entire text block about twice as wide as tall. Generous transparent margin of 8% around text, no cropped strokes. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, alpha only outside letters/outlines. The exact text, top to bottom, must be:
"替空白守门的灯火"
"扉灯祈"
"Tobitō Akari"
Chinese name character sequence: 扉 / 灯 / 祈. Preserve every character exactly, including mixed Chinese/Japanese forms and the given Latin diacritics. No translation, no extra text, no duplicate lettering, no framing, no decorative icons, no panel, no paper, no glow clouds, no background, no checkerboard painted into image. Clean flat front view and crisp edges; NOT metallic 3D.
